claim_scores.rationale: Patches `litellm.responses`, constructs `dspy.LM(..., model_type="responses")`, calls `lm.forward(...)`, and asserts against captured outbound `input` kwargs.
Sends one `user` message with list-form multimodal `content` and inspects `captured[0]["input"][0]["content"]`, preserving order across text, image, and file.
Asserts the first converted item has type `input_text` and preserves the original text field exactly.
Asserts the image converts from nested `image_url.url` chat format to top-level `image_url` with type `input_image`.
Asserts the file converts to `input_file` and preserves both `file_id` and `filename` in the converted payload.
Uses `openai/gpt-5-mini` with `temperature=1.0` and `max_tokens=16000`, satisfying reasoning-model constructor requirements.
